symptom: Local clone HTTP 401/403 and connection-refused failures crossed Electron IPC without their safe transport class, so the renderer showed a generic error; forwarding the engine remediation would also expose GitHub-specific guidance for other hosts.
rule: The bug-fix playbook requires a regression through the real producer and consumer, and zstack-learn requires an eval for every escaped bug. Transport only explicitly allowlisted safe clone error codes across Electron IPC; keep renderer guidance static and host-neutral, and leave unknown errors on the generic fallback.
